text: The legacy request selects LegacySAXResponse, whose onStartRequest resolves responded. The common commit method awaits that promise. Its onStopRequest wrapper calls the async handler and resolves responded without awaiting the returned result; the handler separately awaits handleResponse. The UTF-16 sync test waits for doWebDAVSync and one executeSoon turn before asserting logXML. That is not an explicit parsing-completion condition. A focused test improvement should await a handler completion signal or expected state; no runtime failure was reproduced.
title: A legacy CalDAV response promise is earlier than completed XML parsing
